### Why the North Shore Is a Priority Market for SIT™

The Chicago North Shore —encompassing Wilmette, Winnetka, Glencoe, Highland Park, Lake Forest, and surrounding communities — represents one of the highest-value residential service markets in the Midwest. Median home values consistently exceed$500,000. Homeowners invest significantly in maintenance, improvement, and upgrade services.

Critically: buying decisions in these communities are made based on trust and familiarity, not lowest price —which makes structured territory presence the highest-ROI strategy in this market.

### Which Trade Categories Are Being Evaluated

Current North Shore territory evaluations are open for roofing, HVAC, windows and exterior remodeling, landscaping, and pest control. Because SIT™ approves only one partner per trade per defined territory, category availability varies by specific community. Some trades in some North Shore communities may already be filled.

### What Makes These Territories Valuable

Homeowners in the North Shore corridor are high-repeat customers for home services. A roofing company that establishes genuine familiarity in Winnetka is positioned for not just the initial project — but the ongoing relationship that generates maintenance calls, referrals to neighbors, and repeat business over years.
